title: Restriction of an assignment
statement: Let $P$ be a constraint instance with variable set $V$ and domain $D$. Its participating variables are those that occur in the scope of at least one constraint of $P$. Given an assignment $a:V\\to D$, its restriction to the participating variables sends each such variable to its value under $a$.
hypotheses_covered: A raw CSP instance P with domain D and variable set V
An assignment from V to D
